objective: Implement remediation Steps 1-4 from the exhaustive code review of sovereign@edc4ed1: (1) fail-closed startup + truthful docs, (2) tenant identity resolution, (3) atomicity races, (4) auth primitive hardening.
review_source: Exhaustive Code Review (user-provided, branch main @ edc4ed1)
review_recommendation: BLOCK UNTIL FIXED. Steps 1-4 are the minimum merge bar.
scope_decision: User approved Steps 1-4 only. Steps 5-8 (web-surface security, storage correctness, wire-or-delete dead features, typing hygiene) are OUT OF SCOPE for this pass.
constraints: Tenant-scoping: every store query and route touching tenant data scoped by tenant_id
Error style: lowercase, prefixed "<pkg>: message", wrapped with %w
Adapters live in wiring/, not inline in server/
config.example.yml is source of truth for config shape; keep in sync with internal/server/config.go
migrations/ exists but empty; store creates schema directly (store/store.go)
Multi-tenant SQLite defaults to per_tenant mode; single mode exists
conventions: Package doc comment at top of primary file in each package
Real fixtures over mocks where feasible
Race detector part of normal test run: task test runs go test ./... -race -cover
Security-relevant packages need explicit negative tests

architecture_snapshot.server_assembly: internal/server/server.go: New() -> buildRouter() -> Serve(). buildRouter has no error return (A1 root cause).
architecture_snapshot.tenant_resolution: internal/tenant/resolver.go:40 host->tenant. internal/endpoints/endpoints.go:43,68,88,109 use r.Host as tenantID (A2 bug).
architecture_snapshot.auth: internal/auth/access_token.go (ValidateAccessToken, MintAccessTokenWebID). internal/auth/sqlstore.go (AuthorizeClientIDSecret, CreateAccessAndRefreshTokens). internal/store/auth.go (client CRUD, refresh-token CRUD, CreateUser, InviteTokenByHash, MarkInviteTokenUsed).
architecture_snapshot.invite_flow: internal/server/invite.go + internal/store/auth.go. Read-check-update across 3 statements, no transaction (B7).
architecture_snapshot.first_admin: internal/store/auth.go CreateUser: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users then insert, no transaction, unscoped by tenant (B8).
architecture_snapshot.s3: internal/server/server.go:125-134 newS3Backend; internal/storage/s3.go:20-37 S3Config.Secure never set (B1).

note: A5 (atproto blob empty tenant prefix) is listed in the review under Step 2 but atproto wiring (A4) is out of scope. A5 fix depends on A4 wiring. Treat A5 as DEFERRED with Step 7 (wire-or-delete atproto). Do not attempt A5 in isolation.
breaking_changes_expected: Step 1: strict config parsing will reject existing deployments' configs (document in CHANGELOG as breaking)
Step 4: existing plaintext client secrets and no-exp tokens invalidated (requires migration + documented operator step)
verification_gates: scripts/coverage-gate.sh >=80% total AND no package below 80% (cmd/sovereign 62.5% and internal/authstore 75.7% must rise)
Concurrency tests: invite redemption (exactly one success), first-admin (exactly one admin), SQLite writes
Config strictness test rejects unknown/removed keys
Negative tests per rejected JWT claim
